Password-protected PDFs that need a password prompt cannot be split.

split-pdf.workedExample:
A 12-page ebook, ranges mode, input “1-4,5-8,9-12”:
Group 1: pages 1–4 → ebook-pages-1-4.pdf (4 pages).
Group 2: pages 5–8 → ebook-pages-5-8.pdf (4 pages).
Group 3: pages 9–12 → ebook-pages-9-12.pdf (4 pages).
Outputs: 3 files, bundled as ebook-split.zip.
Extract mode with “2,7,11” instead → 1 file with exactly 3 pages.
